# 08 · Coverage chain for a whole feature

**When:** a new feature end to end. Uses the prompts generated by `npm run agents:init`
(.claude/prompts/playwright-test-coverage.md).

```
Task: Checkout on Swag Labs
Seed file: tests/user/seed-logged-in.spec.ts
Test plan file: specs/checkout.plan.md
Follow CLAUDE.md.
→ planner once → STOP and wait for my review of the plan
→ generator for 1.1, then 2.1–2.3 (data-driven), one after another (not in parallel)
→ healer: run all checkout tests 3x and fix failures one at a time
```

**Human checks:** after the plan (review + commit), after generation (PR review), after healing (classification).
